question: Which of the following is the National waterway no. 4 in India?

options.text: Mahanadi and Brahmani rivers and East Coast Canal
The Brahmaputra river between Sadiya and Dhubri
Godavari and Krishna rivers along with Kakinada Puducherry

solution:
The correct answer is __**Godavari and Krishna rivers along with Kakinada Puducherry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Godavari and Krishna rivers along with Kakinada Puducherry:**
 
• National Waterway 4 (NW-4) is a network of canals, rivers, and lakes in South India.
 
• It connects Kakinada to Puducherry, passing through the Godavari and Krishna rivers.
 
• It includes the Kakinada-Puducherry canals, the Godavari River stretches, and the Krishna River stretches.
 
• It spans across the states of Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and the Union Territory of Puducherry.
 
• It is intended to facilitate cargo and passenger transportation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahanadi and Brahmani rivers and East Coast Canal:**
 
• This description relates to a portion of National Waterway 5 (NW-5).
 
• NW-5 is located in the states of Odisha and West Bengal.
 
• It connects Talcher to Dhamra via the Brahmani River, the Mahanadi delta rivers, and the East Coast Canal.
 
• It is important for the transportation of coal and other commodities.
 
• It is a vital part of the water transport infrastructure of the eastern coast of India.
 
• **The Brahmaputra river between Sadiya and Dhubri:**
 
• This describes National Waterway 2 (NW-2).
 
• NW-2 is located in the state of Assam.
 
• It runs along the Brahmaputra River between Sadiya and Dhubri.
 
• It is crucial for transportation in the northeastern region of India.
 
• It is important for both cargo and passenger traffic.
 
• **The Ganga River between Allahabad-Haldia:**
 
• This describes National Waterway 1 (NW-1).
 
• NW-1 is located in the states of Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, and West Bengal.
 
• It runs along the Ganga River between Allahabad (Prayagraj) and Haldia.
 
• It is the longest national waterway in India.
 
• It is a very important route for inland water transportation.
